invocation_1.failure_point: report assembly after predict_bass.score() returned and before any artifact write; KeyError 'estimator_name'
invocation_1.cause: wrong metadata field name in the reporting block of the runner; the frozen record exposes 'family', not 'estimator_name'

why_repetition_cannot_bias_the_result: The frozen predictor is a pure function of the frozen coefficients, intercept and scaler applied to label-free Phase A feature values. It consumes no randomness, performs no file access at scoring time, and reads no human label. Its output is therefore a deterministic function of frozen inputs. The only defect in invocation 1 was a post-prediction metadata field name in the reporting block; no feature, coefficient, threshold, decision rule or methodological parameter was altered, and no human answer was visible at any point.
integrity_note: This record is separate from the frozen artifact and from the prediction freeze record so that neither had to be edited to accommodate it. Both retain their PI-authorized hashes exactly.
